physical_blocks.exact_text: Listing 16.2.4.1.3 Overdose of Study Drug  (F-627, GRAN®) for All Treatment Periods – Safety Analysis Set

Note: [1] Relative dose intensity (%) = (Actual dose intensity/ Planned dose intensity)*100；
For F-627, Actual dose intensity = Actual cumulative dose / Total frequency of drug administration；
For GRAN®, Actual dose intensity = Actual cumulative dose / Weight / Actual days of drug administration. The last valid weight value measured before each chemotherapy cycle will
be used for analysis.
Overdose is defined as equal to or more than 20% of the prescribed dose.
Programming notes: relative dose intensity (%) is rounded to integer, and statistics for decimal places refer to SAP.
